config.title: Configuration (read-only)
config.hint: The source of truth is config.json; edit it on the Settings tab.

settings.title: Settings
settings.restartHint: Some changed fields require an orchestrator restart to take effect.

max_workers.label: Workers
max_workers.desc: How many python model workers run in parallel (ws-daemons don't count).

poll_interval_ms.label: Poll interval (ms)
poll_interval_ms.desc: How often the orchestrator re-scans the queue and drop folders.

stream_window_ms.label: Stream window (ms)
stream_window_ms.desc: Size of the audio window sent to the daemon per binary frame.

stream_chunk_ms.label: Stream chunk (ms)
stream_chunk_ms.desc: Max audio per streaming session; then a fresh session on a new connection.

daemon_registry_ttl_ms.label: Registry TTL (ms)
daemon_registry_ttl_ms.desc: A daemon is ready only if its heartbeat is within this TTL.

drop_stable_ms.label: Drop stability (ms)
drop_stable_ms.desc: A dropped file is claimed only after its mtime has been stable this long (guards against mid-copy).

max_requeue_attempts.label: Max requeue
max_requeue_attempts.desc: How many times to requeue a job on transport failure before failing it.

default_model.label: Default model
default_model.desc: Model used for jobs that don't specify one.

ffmpeg_path.label: ffmpeg path
ffmpeg_path.desc: Path to ffmpeg.exe used to convert audio to pcm16le 16k mono.

engine.label: Engine
engine.desc: Engine family for language routing (e.g. whisper).

model_name.label: Model
model_name.desc: Model name this daemon is bound to (ggml-<model>.bin file).
